ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Vulkan headers of the Khronos Group
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The C headers of the Vulkan API (vulkan/*.h and vk_video/*.h) of the Vulkan-Headers release vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0. Header only: the Vulkan functions are loaded at run time (volk in the Vulkan render system of Ogre), so nothing links to a Vulkan library. The C++ bindings (vulkan.hpp and the C++ modules) are not part of it.
